rows.label: tlk70000016_01_msg0001
rows.name:
I don't really understand girls,
Nii-chans... You feel the same way,
right?

rows.label: tlk70000016_01_msg0002
rows.name:
The other day, I made medicine from
the bugs we collected and tried to get
a girl I know to drink it...

rows.label: tlk70000016_01_msg0003
rows.name:
She said, "Don't bring that gross
stuff near me!" Can you believe it?! I
just don't understand girls!

rows.label: tlk70000016_01_msg0004
rows.name:
Bugs are super cool! How can a
medicine made of 100% cool things
be gross?! I don't get it at all!
